verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs say it aggregates occurrences of the same error into Items through a default 'intelligent' grouping algorithm. When that algorithm splits or combines occurrences wrongly, users can define Custom Fingerprinting Rules, and they can also manually merge items into groups. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the default fingerprint is derived from the stack trace, and independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping accuracy at scale.
